Fork tree management and vote replay logic with duplicate detection and root publishing.

# Purpose
This C file implements the core logic for a `fd_ghost` data structure that tracks a fork tree of blocks or slots and the stake that votes for each branch. It provides the life-cycle functions [`fd_ghost_new`](<#fd_ghost_new>), [`fd_ghost_join`](<#fd_ghost_join>), [`fd_ghost_leave`](<#fd_ghost_leave>), [`fd_ghost_delete`](<#fd_ghost_delete>), and [`fd_ghost_verify`](<#fd_ghost_verify>) for creating, attaching to, checking, and releasing a ghost object that lives in workspace-backed shared memory. The object contains a pool of ghost elements plus hash and slot maps, and the code uses these structures to store each block hash, its slot, parent and child links, duplicate links, and stake totals.

The file also defines the main fork-choice and vote-processing operations. Functions such as [`fd_ghost_init`](<#fd_ghost_init>), [`fd_ghost_insert`](<#fd_ghost_insert>), [`fd_ghost_head`](<#fd_ghost_head>), [`fd_ghost_replay_vote`](<#fd_ghost_replay_vote>), [`fd_ghost_rooted_vote`](<#fd_ghost_rooted_vote>), [`fd_ghost_publish`](<#fd_ghost_publish>), [`fd_ghost_gca`](<#fd_ghost_gca>), [`fd_ghost_is_ancestor`](<#fd_ghost_is_ancestor>), and [`fd_ghost_invalid`](<#fd_ghost_invalid>) update the tree, move stake through ancestry, select the current head, prune old roots, and test ancestry and validity. Duplicate detection is handled with [`process_duplicate`](<#process_duplicate>) and [`process_duplicate_confirmed`](<#process_duplicate_confirmed>), and [`fd_ghost_print`](<#fd_ghost_print>) writes a tree view for debugging. The file is an implementation file for the `fd_ghost.h` interface and exposes the public API for managing and querying the ghost tree.
